Md. Talib @ Abutalib @ Talib .... .... Petitioner/Applicant Versus The State of Jharkhand .... ....
Opposite Party
----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
----
For the Petitioner/Applicant : Mr. Rahul Pandey, Adv. For the State : Mr. Anup Pawan Topno,
A.P.P.
----
th 04/Dated: 20 February, 2023
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 15.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Chanho P.S. Case No.137 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 376 and 313 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It appears that the applicant is accused of committing rape on the false pretext of marriage.
The relationship was since long and both the parties are major.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the fact that both parties are major, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned J.M.F.C., Ranchi in connection with Chanho P.S. Case No.137 of 2022, subject to condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
